g.text: How the controller's own type declaration reaches the read gate, the write gate and configuration verification — ADR-003.
one read per scope, over a transient
and stamps it onto the tag
the point degrades, the group survives
Each converter states what it expects, rather than
one of them phrasing itself as an exception to the other:
elementary code and is contradicted by a structure
LogixStringConverter is the inverse: it requires a
structure, and holds it to the configured capacity.
Absent metadata (null) is unverifiable, not a contradiction — every implementation reports None for it.
In the read batch the byte-size backstop stands in for the check there.
